data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: When this story is complete, `.github/workflows/review-sub-pr.yml` exists and triggers on PRs whose BASE branch matches `session/**`, `session-**`, `session_**`, or `bug-batch/**`

## Implementation Notes

Write a behavioral test (`tests/workflows/test-review-sub-pr-trigger.sh`) that asserts the contents and trigger conditions of `.github/workflows/review-sub-pr.yml` BEFORE the workflow file is created. The test must fail (RED) because the workflow file does not exist yet.

Test approach (Given/When/Then):
- **Given**: a checked-out repo with `.github/workflows/review-sub-pr.yml` present
- **When**: `actionlint .github/workflows/review-sub-pr.yml` is run AND `yq` is used to extract the `on.pull_request.branches` field
- **Then**: actionlint exits 0 (schema-valid) AND the branches list contains all four required patterns: `session/**`, `session-**`, `session_**`, `bug-batch/**`

The test should also check that the workflow's job invokes (or composes from) the existing LLM reviewer logic in `plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh` so the sub-PR review reuses the same dispatch path as the integration review.

Update `.test-index` with a `[test_review_sub_pr_trigger]` RED marker for `.github/workflows/review-sub-pr.yml`.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Associated tests | Test classification |
|-------------|--------|------------------|---------------------|
| `tests/workflows/test-review-sub-pr-trigger.sh` | create | (this IS the test) | needs-creation |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | n/a (marker only) |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] `tests/workflows/test-review-sub-pr-trigger.sh` exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/workflows/test-review-sub-pr-trigger.sh
- [ ] Test is initially failing (RED) because `.github/workflows/review-sub-pr.yml` does not yet exist
  Verify: ! bash tests/workflows/test-review-sub-pr-trigger.sh
- [ ] `.test-index` updated with RED marker `[test_review_sub_pr_trigger]` for `.github/workflows/review-sub-pr.yml`
  Verify: grep '\[test_review_sub_pr_trigger\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] Test asserts all four base-ref patterns (session/**, session-**, session_**, bug-batch/**)
  Verify: grep -E 'session/\*\*|session-\*\*|session_\*\*|bug-batch/\*\*' tests/workflows/test-review-sub-pr-trigger.sh | wc -l | grep -qE '[4-9]|[1-9][0-9]+'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
